lead: Competitive intelligence across EFB, flight planning, and dispatch vendors reveals active customer wins and product releases, with low-cost carrier deployments appearing across specific supplier portfolios during the rolling year.

insights.title: Royal Air Maroc Selects Thales AvioBook
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is a full-service carrier utilizing an EFB platform for cockpit operations.
insights.caveat: The exact scope of the fleet transition was not detailed in the captured text beyond the five-year duration.

insights.title: IFS Secures LCC and Regional Carrier Wins
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFBOne customer base by securing deployments with MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet.
insights.aviation_context: MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is classified as an LCC, and fastjet is an African low-cost carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured source text describes MY FREIGHTER's operations using cargo terminology alongside its LCC status.

insights.title: Jeppesen Releases FliteDeck Pro 5.3
insights.finding: Jeppesen released version 5.3 of FliteDeck Pro, introducing the Enroute Profile View feature for commercial flight crews.
insights.aviation_context: Enroute profile views assist pilots in visualizing terrain and airspace constraints along their flight path.
insights.caveat: Specific airline deployment figures for this version release were not reported in the signal.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Enhances Lido mPilot
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems launched Lido mPilot 7.3, adding aircraft-specific taxiway restrictions to Airport Moving Maps.
insights.aviation_context: Airport Moving Maps provide real-time self-positioning on airport surface diagrams during taxi.
insights.caveat: Adoption metrics across Lufthansa Systems' broader customer base were not provided.

insights.title: TransNusa Expands Skywise Collaboration with Navblue
insights.finding: TransNusa signed an agreement with Navblue for Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+.
insights.aviation_context: The software integrates flight and technical operations for real-time fleet health monitoring.
insights.caveat: This agreement marks the first deployment of these specific products in Indonesia.
